items.headline: What Week 12's unexpected results mean for Rivalry Week and beyond
items.description: After another chaotic weekend, we look at the playoff and conference races on the line with one game to go.

items.headline: Nick Poulos accounts for 3 TDs, including go-ahead score, to help Ohio edge Ball State 35-28
items.description: — Nick Poulos accounted for three touchdowns, including the go-ahead score with 1:16 remaining, as Ohio rallied in the fourth quarter to beat Ball State 35-28 on Tuesday night.

items.headline: Ohio hosts Ball State in MAC play
items.description: Ball State (3-7) at Ohio (7-3), Nov. 17 at 7 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Sizing up college football's best races down the homestretch
items.description: From spots in the CFP and SEC title game to the hunt for bowl eligibility, there's still a lot on the line.

items.headline: Miami (Ohio) flagged for distracting images during FG attempt
items.description: Miami (Ohio) was penalized for unsportsmanlike conduct for displaying multiple images of uprights on a stadium video screen during an opponent's field goal attempt.

items.headline: True freshman QB Drew Bellisari rallies Miami (Ohio) to 34-17 victory over Ohio in debut
items.description: — Miami (Ohio) scored 34 unanswered points behind true freshman quarterback Drew Bellisari in his first collegiate game, and the RedHawks spotted Ohio 17 points before ending the Bobcats' six-game win streak with a 34-17 victory on Tuesday night.
